conclusions: CDE on T2 confirms a code-language service classification; does not prove a commercial dictionary, codebook identity or plaintext.
T1 lacks visible CDE only within the exposed images. Art41 prevents upgrading this to a categorical exclusion of code language.
Address-inclusive counts125/34 are consistent with primary word-count rules. Marks50/100 were already known; their recollation is not a new discovery.
Both forms record London Mcl. and an Angleterre Eastern note, but Mcl. and the full actual network path remain unresolved.
The complete applicable1937tariff has not been read. Current archival-reproduction tariffs in phase7 are unrelated.
BLUME remains unidentified; abbreviated-address regulations do not prove a specific registration.
